name: Peppers Moonah Links Resort
signature: A full golf resort at Fingal — two Peter Thomson-designed courses, comfortable accommodation, and the Peninsula's most complete golf destination
editorNote:
Peppers Moonah Links is the Peninsula's dedicated golf resort — a full-service property at Fingal with two 18-hole courses designed by Peter Thomson (five-time British Open champion), comfortable lodge-style accommodation, a restaurant and bar, and the kind of package that means you arrive Friday, play two rounds, eat well, and leave Sunday without having to organise anything.

The Legends Course is the more challenging of the two and is ranked among the best public-access golf courses in Victoria. The Open Course is more forgiving. Both are set in coastal heathland with views toward Bass Strait and a layout that rewards local knowledge — ask the pro shop for course tips before your first round.

Good for golf-focused groups and couples where one half wants golf and the other wants Peninsula wine and food within easy reach.
whyWeGo: The Peninsula's only dedicated golf resort — two courses, proper accommodation, and nothing else to organise.
ifOnlyOneThing: Play the Legends Course and book the pro shop lesson first if it is your first visit — the heathland layout punishes overconfidence.
